IssueOrder.description: Where a Linear issue stands in its project, as the intake saw it.

milestone.description: The issue's milestone; null without one.

sort_order.description: The issue's manual order in Linear. Lower comes first.

MilestoneOrder.description: Where a milestone stands in its project.

sort_order.description: The milestone's manual order in its project. Lower comes first.

target_date.description: The milestone's target date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; null without one.

ViewChanged.description:
An issue that entered or left a saved Linear view, or a Linear project's issues that a trigger's
filter keeps, since the previous poll.

baseline.description: True when the event came from the first poll of its stream.

linear_id.description:
Linear's id of what the event is about: the issue, history entry or comment. A webhook's
state change has no history entry, so it holds the issue's id.

order.description:
Where the issue stands in its project; null without a project, and absent from an issue the
intake last read before it kept the order.

project.description: The issue's project name; null without one.

project_id.description: Linear's id of the issue's project; null without one.

stream.description:
The stream, `linear.project:<project>`, then `:` and the trigger's filter as JSON when it has
one. Project events only.

triggers.description: The triggers the event matched, so the triggers it requests tasks for; may be empty.

url.description: The issue's page, or the comment's for a comment.

view.description: The view, as the trigger names it. View events only.

description:
An issue that entered or left a saved Linear view, or a Linear project's issues that a trigger's
filter keeps, since the previous poll.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: linear.issue.entered
